description: This file defines a Java interface MessageBuilder which provides a mutable, fluent API for constructing immutable Message objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for setting payloads, headers, extra data, and response consumers, as well as creating header builders for messages.

methods.name: newHeadersBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new MessageHeadersBuilder instance for constructing message headers, either with a String or a ThingId, along with direction and subject.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Sets the payload content for the message builder.

methods.name: rawPayload
methods.description: Sets the raw byte buffer payload for the message.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Adds additional JsonObject data to the message.

methods.name: responseConsumer
methods.description: Associates a response consumer with the message builder, which is stored but not serialized.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the immutable Message object based on the current state of the builder.
